stories.headline: Trump demands probe into 'record setting error' after third-quarter GDP data gets massive revision higher
stories.summary: Trump has called for an investigation into a significant upward revision to Q3 GDP data. The demand raises questions about the timing and accuracy of economic reporting.
stories.why_matters: GDP revisions directly impact Fed policy expectations and equity valuations; political scrutiny of economic data can influence market confidence.

stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition says Houthis attacked Aramco's Jazan refinery
stories.summary: The Saudi-led coalition reported that Houthis launched an attack on Aramco's Jazan refinery. Such attacks on critical energy infrastructure risk supply disruptions.
stories.why_matters: Energy infrastructure attacks affect global oil supply and prices; WTI crude is up $0.82 to $82.24, reflecting geopolitical risk premium.

stories.headline: Israel's Eisenkot reaches deal with left-wing faction as coalition talks gain steam
stories.summary: Israeli political negotiations have progressed with Eisenkot securing a deal with a left-wing faction. Coalition formation continues amid ongoing regional tensions.
stories.why_matters: Middle East political stability affects commodity prices and geopolitical risk appetite; market volatility can follow coalition shifts in the region.

calendar.note: FOMC communications drive rate expectations and equity/bond repricing; combined with Economic Policy Uncertainty data, sets tone for year-end volatility.
Leading indicators help forecast near-term economic momentum and inform Fed policy trajectory.
EPU index reflects market anxiety; elevated readings often correlate with higher VIX and risk-off positioning.

concept.title: Geopolitical Risk Premium and Inflation Signals
concept.one_liner: Energy infrastructure attacks, political disputes, and GDP data scrutiny are pushing crude higher while bonds flatten, signaling lingering inflation concern beneath a weakening equity close.
concept.explanation: With WTI crude up $0.82 on Houthi-Aramco tensions and Iraq closing borders, energy supply risk is pricing in. The 10Y UST at 4.91% (down 1 bp) and VIX at 26.36 (down 0.26) show bond demand offsetting equity weakness (S&P -21 bps), suggesting investors are rotating to safety. Trump's GDP revision probe adds political noise to economic data credibility, creating uncertainty around Fed pivot timing and real growth.
concept.market_link: Energy shocks + political/data uncertainty typically widen credit spreads and boost volatility; the flat 2Y (no change) despite 10Y decline hints at terminal rate stickiness, limiting rally room.

narrative: Equities closed modestly lower (-0.29%) as geopolitical risks in the Middle East pushed crude up $0.82, while Treasuries rallied on demand for safety. VIX dipped to 26.36, but political scrutiny of GDP data and ongoing regional tensions leave year-end positioning fragile heading into Friday's FOMC release and economic data.
